meaning: The selected Church coextends with the visible criterion, through the spiritual-community predicate as middle term: the Church is visible (OPEN); a visible society in the scope is spiritual (OPEN and contested, restricted scope) and hence, being visible and spiritual, the Church (OPEN). The Church-is-spiritual inclusion is not needed. With STMT-CHURCH-HAS-JOINT-ASPECT-CRITERION it shows the visible and joint calibrations coincide under these premises.
